acceptanceBoundary: This declares independently captured reference identities and equivalent required invocations. Candidate compile/assemble, linking/artifact and produced-program qualification belong to issues 713, 714 and 715; GCC verbose observations are not independent candidate execution receipts.

argumentEquivalence.compile: insert -v after the first -quiet unless -fpreprocessed; insert -version immediately before -o
argumentEquivalence.failure: observed phases form a nonempty prefix; successful cases include all planned phases

temporaryNames.appliesTo: driver plans, verbose traces and execution streams; artifacts are never normalized
temporaryNames.reason: the driver draws temporary file names from mkstemp, so they differ between otherwise identical runs
temporaryNames.replacement: <tmp-N> plus the original suffix, N numbering distinct names in order of first appearance per stream
